las-medulas-roman-gold-mine.research_focus: Roman hydraulic gold mining at Las Médulas in northwest Spain: the ruina montium method, the aqueduct channels and reservoirs, and the washing sluices
las-medulas-roman-gold-mine.scene: A torrent of water bursts from a tunnel mouth and tears down a collapsing hillside, while Roman labourers in tunics rake the slurry through timber sluices below; no legionaries in armour

kutna-hora-silver-strike.research_focus: medieval silver mining at Kutná Hora in Bohemia around 1300: miners' hooded tunics, hand windlasses, tallow lamps, and illuminated mining scenes such as the Kutná Hora gradual
kutna-hora-silver-strike.scene: A medieval miner in a hooded tunic is winched up a narrow timbered shaft on a hand windlass, a basket of silver ore beside him and a tallow lamp in his hand

joachimsthal-silver-rush.research_focus: the silver town of Joachimsthal in the Ore Mountains in the early 1500s, Agricola's De re metallica woodcuts, and the striking of the first thaler coins
joachimsthal-silver-rush.scene: A Renaissance mint worker brings a hammer down on a coin die at a heavy wooden block, a heap of large silver coins beside him and a mine headframe on the forested slope behind; the coin faces are blank discs

zacatecas-silver-strike.research_focus: the 1546 silver discovery at the Cerro de la Bufa, Zacatecas, and early Spanish colonial mining in the Mexican highlands with mule trains and indigenous labourers
zacatecas-silver-strike.scene: A Spanish prospector in a morion helmet holds a lump of silver ore up to the light at the foot of a crested rocky hill, pack mules and indigenous guides waiting behind him on the dry highland

minas-gerais-gold-rush.research_focus: the gold rush in Minas Gerais, Brazil, in the 1690s and early 1700s: bandeirante prospectors, the wooden bateia pan, and enslaved African miners working river gravels
minas-gerais-gold-rush.scene: A bandeirante in a wide-brimmed hat and quilted jerkin stands knee-deep in a forest stream, swirling a broad conical wooden pan in which grains of gold catch the light

brazil-diamonds-discovered.research_focus: the diamond diggings around Tejuco (Diamantina), Brazil, in the 1720s and 1730s, and Carlos Julião's watercolours of diamond washing
brazil-diamonds-discovered.scene: A gold panner in colonial Brazil pauses over his wooden pan and lifts a single small rough crystal between finger and thumb, studying it against the light beside a rocky highland stream

berezovsk-first-russian-gold.research_focus: Erofei Markov's 1745 gold find near Yekaterinburg in the Urals, and Russian peasant dress and Ural forest landscape of the mid 18th century
berezovsk-first-russian-gold.scene: A bearded Russian peasant in a belted kaftan kneels at a shallow pit among birch and pine, turning over a chunk of quartz veined with gold

reed-gold-nugget-north-carolina.research_focus: the Reed farm on Little Meadow Creek, North Carolina, in 1799, and the interiors of German-American backcountry farmhouses of the period
reed-gold-nugget-north-carolina.scene: A large rough lump of gold props open the plank door of a log farmhouse, a boy with a fishing pole stepping past it into the daylight without a glance

georgia-gold-rush.research_focus: the Georgia gold rush around Dahlonega and Auraria in 1829 and the 1830s: placer mining with pans and rocker cradles in the Appalachian foothills
georgia-gold-rush.scene: Prospectors in frock coats and slouch hats crowd a wooded Appalachian creek, one working a wooden rocker cradle while another holds up a pan to show the gold in it

eureka-diamond-found.research_focus: the 1867 find of the Eureka diamond near Hopetown on the Orange River in the Cape Colony, and Boer farm life of the 1860s
eureka-diamond-found.scene: A farm boy crouches on the stony bank of a wide river in the dry South African veld, picking one glinting pebble out of a handful of ordinary stones

kimberley-diamond-rush.research_focus: the Kimberley Mine (the Big Hole) in the early 1870s: the patchwork of square claims at different depths and the web of haulage ropes running to the rim
kimberley-diamond-rush.scene: A vast open pit cut into a chessboard of square claims at uneven depths, hundreds of taut haulage ropes fanning from the rim down to diggers working with picks and buckets far below

tombstone-silver-strike.research_focus: Ed Schieffelin's 1877 silver prospecting in the San Pedro Valley, Arizona: his long hair, patched buckskin clothes, pick and rifle, and the desert hills of the area
tombstone-silver-strike.scene: A lone long-haired prospector in patched clothes chips at a rock ledge in a desert of agave and ocotillo, a rifle propped within reach and a burro waiting; no town and no gunfighters

witwatersrand-gold-discovery.research_focus: the 1886 discovery of the Main Reef on Langlaagte farm on the Witwatersrand, the pebbly gold-bearing conglomerate called banket, and the first tent camp of Johannesburg
witwatersrand-gold-discovery.scene: A prospector crouches at a rocky outcrop on open grassy highveld, crushing a piece of pebbly conglomerate in an iron pan, with a scatter of canvas tents and ox wagons on the ridge behind

coolgardie-gold-rush.research_focus: the 1892 Coolgardie gold rush in Western Australia: prospectors walking the track from Southern Cross with wheelbarrows and camels, and dry-blowing for gold without water
coolgardie-gold-rush.scene: A sunburnt prospector pushes a loaded wheelbarrow along a dusty track through dry scrub, a string of pack camels and other walkers strung out ahead of him toward a low ridge

nome-beach-gold-rush.research_focus: the Nome beach diggings of 1899 and 1900 on the Bering Sea coast of Alaska: rocker boxes on the sand, the tent city and the surf
nome-beach-gold-rush.scene: Miners stand shoulder to shoulder along a cold surf line, shovelling beach sand into wooden rocker boxes, with rows of canvas tents on the shore behind and waves breaking at their boots

cullinan-diamond-found.research_focus: the Premier Mine near Pretoria in 1905 and the rough Cullinan diamond, a fist-sized irregular crystal with one flat cleaved face
cullinan-diamond-found.scene: A mine manager in a waistcoat and hat reaches up a rough pit wall and prises out a fist-sized rough crystal with a pocket knife, late sun catching it; the stone is uncut and irregular, not a faceted gem

namib-diamond-rush.research_focus: the 1908 diamond find near Lüderitz in German South West Africa, the desert railway there, and early prospectors crawling the sand to pick up diamonds
namib-diamond-rush.scene: A railway worker kneels on a single desert track half buried by drifting dunes, his shovel laid aside, holding a tiny glinting stone up between his fingers

mir-siberian-diamond-pipe.research_focus: the 1955 Amakinsky expedition that found the Mir kimberlite pipe in Yakutia: geologists' field gear, larch taiga, and prospecting pits
mir-siberian-diamond-pipe.scene: Three geologists in padded jackets and mosquito nets crouch over a freshly dug pit among thin larch trees, one sifting dark crumbly kimberlite through his fingers; faces turned down and away

carlin-trend-gold-discovery.research_focus: Newmont's 1961 exploration of the Carlin area in Nevada: sagebrush hills, drill core boxes, and geologists' field equipment of the early 1960s
carlin-trend-gold-discovery.scene: A geologist in a field hat squints through a hand lens at a dull, ordinary-looking piece of rock on a sagebrush hillside, a drill rig and trays of core behind him; no visible gold anywhere

orapa-diamond-pipe-found.research_focus: De Beers prospecting in the Kalahari of Botswana in the 1960s: soil sampling for garnet and ilmenite indicator grains, sieves, and field Land Rovers
orapa-diamond-pipe-found.scene: A prospector kneels on flat Kalahari sand among thorn trees, shaking a round sieve of soil and picking out tiny garnet grains, a canvas-topped field truck parked behind

serra-pelada-gold-rush.research_focus: the Serra Pelada gold mine in Pará, Brazil, in the early 1980s, as in Sebastião Salgado's photographs: the terraced pit, the pole ladders and the garimpeiros carrying sacks
serra-pelada-gold-rush.scene: An endless column of mud-caked men climbs rough pole ladders up the terraced wall of a huge open pit, each bent under a sack of earth on his shoulders

argyle-diamond-mine-opens.research_focus: the Argyle diamond mine in the East Kimberley of Western Australia in the 1980s: the open pit, haul trucks, and the boab and spinifex country around it
argyle-diamond-mine-opens.scene: A gloved hand holds a few small rough diamonds in its palm in the foreground, and behind it a giant haul truck climbs the benched road of an open pit cut into rugged outback ranges

lac-de-gras-diamonds-found.research_focus: the 1991 diamond discovery at Point Lake near Lac de Gras in Canada's Northwest Territories: tundra, floatplanes, and a small exploration drill camp
lac-de-gras-diamonds-found.scene: A small drill rig and a single canvas tent stand on treeless tundra beside a lake, a floatplane moored at the shore and a tray of grey drill core lying open in the foreground; no people

lesedi-la-rona-diamond-found.research_focus: the Lesedi La Rona rough diamond found at the Karowe mine in Botswana in 2015: its size, frosted surface and irregular shape
lesedi-la-rona-diamond-found.scene: Two gloved hands cradle a rough diamond the size of a tennis ball under a single work lamp, its surface frosted and uneven, with a sorting-plant conveyor dim in the background; the stone is uncut, and no faces are shown
